'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Matt Manning DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Manning]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matt Manning]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Twi'lek Advisor]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2021-throwback-PREF2 2021 Event Decklists 15 PREF2 AOBS Matt Manning 2021.txt|Download]]
